observations: Photo shows a white game console lying flat with a visible PlayStation button-symbol logo on the top edge.
Two white DualSense-style controllers are placed on top of the console, each showing the symbol buttons and touchpad area.
A smartphone is clipped into a third controller-like mount (resembles a mobile clip-on controller, e.g. Backbone/Kishi style), unclear if this is part of the sale.
No model plate, serial number, or distinguishing port/vent pattern is visible to confirm 'Slim' vs standard disc/digital PS5.
No power-on screen, disc tray, or game library screen is shown.
Watermark 'KINGSPLEN GAMING GADGETS' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' overlay the image; no other listing text is legible.

risks.risk: Console may be standard/disc edition rather than Slim, which changes value.
risks.proof: Clear side profile photo or back panel showing port layout and model number (e.g. CFI-2000 series sticker).
risks.if_unproven: priced as standard/base PS5, not Slim

risks.risk: Console may not power on or have internal faults (overheating, disc drive failure, HDMI issues).
risks.proof: Video of console powering on to the home screen and reading a disc or digital game.

risks.risk: Controllers may have stick drift or battery/charging faults.
risks.proof: Short video showing analog stick movement in a menu and controller charging light.

risks.risk: '12 latest games' may be unlicensed, pirated, or already uninstalled before sale.
risks.proof: Screenshot of the game library/home screen showing installed titles.
risks.if_unproven: priced as console only, no games

risks.risk: The clipped-in phone/mobile controller accessory may or may not be included, causing dispute at handover.
risks.proof: Seller explicitly states in writing what is included, confirmed by a photo of all items laid out separately.
risks.if_unproven: priced as console and two controllers only, excluding phone/mobile mount

proof_requests: Photo of the back/side of the console showing the model number sticker or port layout.
Video of the console powering on to the PS5 home screen.
Screenshot of the installed games library.
Video demonstrating both controllers' analog sticks and buttons in a menu.
Clarification and photo confirming whether the phone/mobile controller mount is part of the sale.
response.reason: The photo does not show a model number or distinguishing feature to confirm this is a PS5 Slim versus a standard PS5, a difference that materially affects price, so even a worst-case price cannot be set without that shot.
